senses.gloss:
ITA-1.7.26 vitaṇḍā वितण्डा
Hostile debate, offensive argument
A debate in which no counter-thesis is affirmed, and views are refuted without objective examination.

ITA-7.1.4.25 vitastiḥ वितस्तिः
Distance between extended tips of thumb and little finger
Measure of length equal to the distance between the tip of thumb and the tip of little finger spread out: approximately 9 inches or 22.86 cm, equivalent to 12 angula (23.4 cm).

ITA-9.6.192 vitānabandhaḥ वितानबन्धः
Cephalic bandage
A type of bandage applied over the scalp or head region.
